vote_requests.reason_body: CIP-0073 and CIP-0096 introduce the idea of a minting delegation contract. Minting delegation contracts make it possible for an external party to assign a Validator operator party that will submit a transaction taking reward coupons assigned to the external party, and minting them into Canton Coin owned by the external party, directly in an external wallet controlled by that external party. CIP-0073 introduced this concept as part of an idea called "weighted liveness rewards". Since all liveness rewards were subsequently removed by CIP-0096, CIP-0073 was replaced. However, CIP-0096 retains the concept of minting delegation introduced by CIP-0073. The implementation of minting delegation is complete and introduced by the Splice wallet dar version 0.1.16.
